plainText:
Lusamine's Clefable (Japanese: ルザミーネのピクシー Lusamine's Pixy) is Lusamine's main that she owns in the , , and the .

==In animation==
 
Clefable has been owned by since she was still a . She used to play a lot with and when the two were young. At some point, she evolved into a , and later into a Clefable with a Moon Stone against Lillie's wishes, as shown in a fantasy in A Dream Encounter!.

Clefable debuted as a Cleffa in Lillie's Egg-xhilarating Challenge! in a photograph at Lillie's house, in which she was being held by Lillie. The photo later reappeared in A Glaring Rivalry!. In a flashback in Mission: Total Recall!, she was seen playing with Lillie as a Clefairy.

Clefable physically debuted in Faba's Revenge!, when Lusamine sent her out to battle , only to be recalled when her energy had been drained. When Lusamine was later subjected to Nihilego's control, Clefable was sent out to stop and Lillie in Rescuing the Unwilling!. She briefly battled Snowy and Ash's Lycanroc before Lillie was able to break Clefable free of Nihilego's control by reminding her of their past together.

In The Professors' New Adventure!, Clefable attended the wedding of and alongside its .

Since A Mission of Ultra Urgency!, she has been stationed at the Ultra Guardians' base below the Pokémon School, having been selected by Lusamine to assist Ash and during their Ultra Guardians' missions. She usually greets them when they first arrive before pointing to the monitor where Lusamine, Wicke, and Professor Burnet will make contact.

In Show Me the Metal!, Clefable was cleaning the Ultra Guardians' base when she came across a group of that began eating anything made of metal. Clefable trampled the Meltan, causing them to flee up to the Pokémon School, but they later returned. In the following episode, Clefable learned of their taste for metal and went on to train them to follow her around. Later, she had the Meltan perform a few tricks for Kukui and his class.

===Personality and characteristics===
Clefable has a friendly and playful personality, as seen during 's flashbacks. She has a close bond with Lillie, which allowed her to break free from 's control. Her friendship with Lillie made her the perfect choice of Pokémon to be stationed at the Ultra Guardians' base. Clefable is a thoughtful and helpful Pokémon, as shown in the Poké Problem extra scene for SM089, where she gave a cup of after all of the hard work she had done on studying .

Clefable likes to keep the Ultra Guardians' base tidy, as seen in Show Me the Metal!.

===Moves used===
 
 
 
 

==In the games==
===In the core series===
Lusamine's Clefable appears in and as part of Lusamine's team. Like the rest of her Pokémon, Clefable is kept in an Ultra Ball. Clefable also appears in the end credits of Sun and Moon as part of a photograph taken by the player character, appearing alongside Lusamine's Bewear, Wicke, Faba, an , and some s.

==== ====
 

===In spin-off games===
====Pokémon Masters EX====
While not part of a sync pair with in , Clefable makes an appearance during the story event The Light Devourer.

==In the manga==
 
===Pokémon Adventures===
Clefable first appeared in Unleashing the Incredible Z-Move with Lusamine at Aether Paradise.

In Darkness!! The Mysterious Claws of Necrozma!, it and the rest of Lusamine's team was used to battle a befriended by the Ultra Recon Squad so Lusamine could catch it. Clefable was knocked out after being shot by Naganadel's poison.
